newsitem.title: UK: Buyers back away from UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers back away from UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: Buyers kept their distance form the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday despite slightly lower prices.
"We've been trying hard to get business going, but have got nowhere," said one broker.
"If Chicago keeps coming down we may see some interest on Thursday," said another broker following the sharply lower opening of the U.S. market.
High protein soymeal ex-mill and stores was one stg down for material this year while in the new year prices were one stg up.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was unchanged while July material from Liverpool was one stg down with forward material from Hull and Liverpool unchanged to one stg higher.
Sunflower meal and pellets and corn gluten feed pellets were unchanged. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
